title: Apollo 11 — liftoff from the Moon
notes: NASA onboard/air-to-ground audio, tape 11-03330, GET 005:04:21–33: Eagle ascent stage lifts off Tranquility Base to rejoin Columbia; Houston in the loop

title: CBC TV Nagoya late-night closedown
notes: region-by-region weather cards over a sunset; 'CBC's broadcasts are all finished for today'; JOAR-TV ch5 output-power card over a space animation; relay-station list; CBC galaxy logo; true source youtube w7vXJpZ-v-Y

title: ¡Atención! (numbers station, Spanish)
notes: Conet Project d1-16, Irdial-Discs; Cuban station: '¡Atención!' then five-figure groups in Spanish; three 'final's at the end

title: The Lincolnshire Poacher (numbers station, English)
notes: Conet Project d1-06, Irdial-Discs; the folk tune on a synth, then an English woman reading five-figure groups twice each; attributed to MI6, Cyprus

title: The Swedish Rhapsody (numbers station, German)
notes: Conet Project d1-01, Irdial-Discs; music-box 'Swedish Rhapsody' then a child's voice reading five-figure groups in German; ends 'Ende'

title: Fuji TV (JOCX-TV) last 20 minutes and sign-off
notes: tape static; 'Sound Weather' sung forecast; illegal-radio PSA 'get a licence for your transmitter'; JOCX master-control card 'resting until broadcasts resume'; the dark building the station leaves on air as the sound dies

title: Shortwave interval signals, 1976–77
notes: Greg Shoom's off-air log from Kingston, Ontario: Deutsche Welle, Radio Nederland, Radio Habana Cuba, Voice of Spain, RCI, Radio Nacional de Brasilia, Radio RSA, Voice of Iran, BBC Spanish, Voice of Turkey — the little melodies stations played before sign-on

title: JJY 8 MHz — the last minutes, 31 March 2001
notes: Japanese standard time station JJY shortwave, digitized by N1EA; second ticks, Morse ID burst, the closing announcement in Japanese, then the carrier drops at 0300 UTC and the band goes to noise

title: Fuji TV (JOCX-TV) 1981: FNN news, weather, commercials
notes: FNN news open; 'FNN news ends' into a rocket launch; Utsu Kyumeigan jingle; tomorrow's weather for Tokyo and Kanto over the night city; Kuishinbo Banzai opening

title: KABC-7 Los Angeles late-night commercials and sign-off
license: unknown (off-air VHS; commercials and station content copyrighted; anthem PD)
notes: Oct 1989 off-air tape: Dianetics testimonial, 'the owner's manual for the human mind', 'Channel 7 leaves the air', Roger Carroll's good morning, High Flight poem, Moog national anthem. Tier B: 6 windows.

title: MBS Osaka, February 1986: breaks, news, the Manila relay
notes: night-game eyecatch; Takara Can Chu-hi with Boy George; MBS News open; tomorrow's Kansai weather map; the Marcos press conference relayed from Manila dissolving into rainbow bars; anchor on the phone to the Manila reporter

title: Apollo 13: Houston, We've Got a Problem
notes: NASA/NARA documentary with real air-to-ground and flight-director loop: 'stir up your cryo tanks', 'Houston, we've had a problem', launch loop, 'Aquarius, you're go for the burn', 'farewell Aquarius', 'we show you on the mains'

title: NHK General TV closedown (JOAK-TV)
notes: NHK sign-off card: 'this ends General TV's broadcasts', 'check the stove and the locks before bed', JOAK-TV 1 ident; VHS; only 40 s survive so 3 windows

title: NTV (JOAX-TV) sign-on and Ohayo Tenki morning weather
notes: 5:15 am sign-on ident; Ohayo Tenki title and greeting; AMeDAS rainfall map; today's weather map; Mt Fuji radar; tide table; Betamax

title: A Day Called X
notes: CBS/FCDA dramatized H-bomb evacuation of Portland, Oregon; air-raid warning; sirens; 'This is a CONELRAD radio alert… 640 or 1240 on your regular radio receiver'

title: A is for Atom
notes: GE animated atom primer; Dr. Atom; 'a hundred billion billion atoms'; chain reaction; 'not one but many giants: the warrior, the destroyer'

title: Design for Dreaming
notes: GM Motorama 1956 musical; sung throughout; 'everyone says the future is strange'; Eldorado, Buick Centurion, the kitchen of tomorrow

title: Duck and Cover
notes: Federal Civil Defense Administration; Bert the Turtle; 'duck and cover'

title: Operation Cue
notes: FCDA study of the 1955 Nevada test (1964 revision): a radio transmitter broadcasting from tape before the shot, mannequins facing the blast, 'on the silent desert the test objects waited', the shot, 'this time it was only a test'

title: Television Commercials (1950s–1960s)
notes: Prelinger reel of 1950s–60s spots: Alka-Seltzer, 'like sending your sinuses to Arizona', NAB code PSA, Coca-Cola stewardess, Colt 45, 'the blahs', Heinz pickles

title: Tokyo Station, Yamanote and Keihin-Tohoku platforms, 16 May 1993
notes: mono cassette recording by 足元の丸印: departure melodies, automatic announcements, doors, trains; from about 3:45 platforms 3 and 4

title: TV-DX reception of NTV (JOAX-TV) test card and opening
notes: a DXer's long-distance reception: test card with tone, then the doves sign-on, JOAX-TV, channel 4; true source youtube 0B6bMEI_aKw

title: Ueno Station platforms 16 and 17, July 1991
notes: mono cassette recording by 足元の丸印: 沢田敏子's automatic announcements for the Asama, Hakusan, Hitachi and Soyokaze limited expresses, departure melodies, the trains

title: Universal Newsreel: First U.S. Satellite Launched
notes: Universal Newsreel, Feb 1958: Jupiter-C / Explorer 1 at Cape Canaveral, 'the countdown reaches zero', 'broadcasting to the world its coded scientific data'; second story: Nasser and the United Arab Republic

title: UVB-76, 'The Buzzer', 4625 kHz
notes: Russian military channel-marker beacon buzzing since the 1970s; WebSDR recording 4 June 2024 with a voice message somewhere in it

title: Voyager Golden Record — greetings to the universe
notes: NASA's 55 greetings from the Voyager Golden Record, concatenated in NASA's order from soundcloud.com/nasa/sets/golden-record-greetings-to-the (also archive.org/details/voyager_202608); Akkadian, Amoy, Arabic… English 'Hello from the children of planet Earth', Japanese, Latin, Persian, Russian, Sumerian, Vietnamese, Welsh, Wu

title: 1970s VX-format tape: dubbed Coronet film and slide commercials
notes: late-1970s Quasar/VX home tape, station and exact year unknown; a Coronet deer film dubbed into Japanese, 'The End', then slide ads read by an announcer (ski sale, Park Hotel, Hotel Sounkyo); true source youtube Q7g9xPfsqcw

title: WWV, 5 MHz, 8 December 1991
notes: NIST time station WWV, Fort Collins; recorded by Myke Dodge Weiskopf in Rockford IL; ticks, the 500/600 Hz tone, 'At the tone, two hours nineteen minutes Coordinated Universal Time' in the short-lived 1991 digital voice
